roster_source: Scrape of public team roster pages — 278 NCAA Division I men's & women's tennis programs across 24 conferences
roster_conferences: Southland / WAC / Patriot / Big Sky / MEAC / SWAC

sources.socioeconomic: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey 5-year — public Summary File bulk files (www2.census.gov)
sources.geography: U.S. Census Bureau 2023 Gazetteer + TIGER/Line cb_2023 counties
sources.tennis_access: OpenStreetMap via Overpass API (sport=tennis), © OSM contributors, ODbL
sources.rosters: Public NCAA Division I tennis team roster pages (278 programs)

limitations: Outcome = NCAA Division I tennis players on the 278 programs the scraper could read (of ~300 D1 programs); it undercounts true D1 representation for counties whose players attend the ~30 schools not covered.
Predictors use ACS 5-year vintage (roster_year - 1); tennis courts are a single current OSM snapshot.
13468 of 22605 player-seasons have an international or unresolved hometown and are not placed in a U.S. county.
